subject.title: Dashboard: preview widget — live URL embed, dev-server preview, browser-backed inspection

question: Should OpenClaw accept a trusted bundled Dashboard preview widget now, and what boundary should Phase 1 keep between passive URL embedding and later dev-server/browser-inspection capabilities?
rationale: The request is aligned with web-frontend and computer-use goals, but it would add a privileged browser/process surface that automation cannot safely approve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve A Narrow Phase 1
options.body: Keep this issue open for a trusted builtin that embeds operator-approved URLs with reload and viewport chrome after the dashboard substrate lands, while tracking dev-server and browser diagnostics as separate security-reviewed follow-ups.

options.title: Defer Until Widget SDK Direction
options.body: Wait for the bundled-widget SDK and dashboard-stack decisions before accepting any preview-specific implementation.

options.title: Route Outside Core
options.body: Ask for an external plugin or ClawHub package unless maintainers decide the preview needs bundled first-party privileges.

recommendation.title: Approve A Narrow Phase 1
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a trusted builtin that embeds operator-approved URLs with reload and viewport chrome after the dashboard substrate lands, while tracking dev-server and browser diagnostics as separate security-reviewed follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: The current product/security choice depends most directly on the recently merged native plugin-tab seam and Control UI ownership boundary.
